name: late_favorite
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Near-settlement favorite. With 45-120 seconds left, buy the side whose touch is inside 0.80-0.90 and hold it to settlement. One attempt per condition per round; a fill or a cancel is not re-entered. maker_entry 0 (default) crosses the ask as a taker (order reason late-taker). maker_entry 1 rests a post-only bid at the touch and cancels it once time_left falls below min_time_left. Not in the default enabled set. The strategy loader does not require a lua_ prefix; the registry id is the directory name late_favorite.
